prompt.title: Rehearse your next hard moment
prompt.text: Think of a moment coming up where you usually snap, freeze or give in. Decide now how you'll respond, picture it, and promise yourself.
prompt.glossText: The book says there's a gap between what happens to you (the stimulus) and what you do (your response). This exercise uses it.
prompt.whyItMatters: In the moment, the old reaction is faster than any good intention. Rehearsing gives your chosen response a head start. Picturing it once makes it easier to reach for when it counts.

list.empty: Nothing rehearsed yet. Think of a moment this week that usually gets the worst of you.

form.triggerPrompt: What's coming up that usually gets a bad reaction from you?
form.triggerPlaceholder: e.g. Sunday lunch, when Dad brings up my job again.
form.expectedOnPrompt: When is it likely to happen?
form.usualReactionPrompt: How do you normally react, honestly?
form.usualReactionPlaceholder: e.g. I get short with him and leave the table early.
form.costPrompt: What does that reaction cost you, and them?
form.costPlaceholder: e.g. The whole afternoon feels ruined, and Mum ends up upset.
form.chosenResponsePrompt: Picture the moment. What do you say and do? Write it as a short scene.
form.chosenResponsePlaceholder: e.g. I take a breath and say: "I know you worry. Ask me one question about it and I'll answer properly." Then I ask about his week.
form.chosenResponseHint: Two or three sentences. Say what you'll do, not what you'll avoid.
form.chosenResponseRequired: Write a little more: what you'll say and do.
form.promisePrompt: In one line, what do you promise yourself for that moment?
form.promisePlaceholder: e.g. On Sunday I'll answer Dad calmly and ask him one question back.
form.promiseHint: Saving this adds it to Your promises, due on the date above.

followUp.keptPrompt: Did you keep the promise? This updates it in Your promises.
followUp.learnedPrompt: What did you notice in the gap before you responded?
followUp.learnedPlaceholder: e.g. The breath helped. Having a question ready did more.

checklist.trigger: Name a moment that's coming up
checklist.usual: Write what you usually do and what it costs
checklist.scene: Write your new response as a short scene
checklist.promise: Promise yourself in one line, with a date

guide.inShort: You'll pick one moment that's coming up, write what you usually do and what you'd rather do, then promise yourself. About ten minutes. After the moment passes, you'll come back and say how it went.
howTo: Tap "Add rehearsal" and name the moment and when it's likely to happen.
Write honestly how you usually react, and what that costs you and others.
Write the response you'd rather give as a short scene: what you say, what you do.
Write a one-line promise to yourself. Saving it adds it to Your promises.
Once the date has passed, open the rehearsal and fill in Afterwards.
Tap "Mark done" once one rehearsal has all four parts.

guide.afterwards: Before the moment, read your scene once more. Afterwards, come back within a day and fill in what happened, even if it went the old way. Then rehearse the next one.
